intent: A chalk-pale burial kit — a close niche hood with a stepped lintel lip and keystone, a long dust-white tunic with one cold slate shoulder and a grave tag on a wire, broad linen cuffs and shin wraps, and a larger mallet and chisel hung at the thighs — that reads as a pale cut-stone figure with cold slate and rust accents from the high camera.
requests: A centre skirt panel or wider thigh flaps for a long tunic: Kit.flaps leaves a body-coloured split down the front of a knee-length skirt.
A belt prop that may hang from the lower torso: the C81 rule pushes any hanging tool onto the thighs, so the mallet and chisel swing with the leg rather than the belt.
A stone-dust white / pale quarry grey in Kit.colors, colder than oatmeal and paler than iron, so the dust family shares one palette.
